Building a Cyber Immune future

With a nearly 30-year track record of protecting individuals and organizations around the world, we’re a team of over 6,000 professionals working towards a Cyber Immune future.

From one solution to global protection

In 1989, Eugene Kaspersky's computer was infected by the Cascade virus. This single moment went on to shape the future of the entire cybersecurity industry.

Starting with the fight against one virus, Eugene then grew Kaspersky into a global leader in cybersecurity, protecting users and organisations around the world from complex and sophisticated cyber threats.

A brief history of Kaspersky

Twenty years of Kaspersky’s history and important events in the cybersecurity industry.

1989
Eugene Kaspersky begins fighting viruses
Eugene Kaspersky discovers a virus called Cascade.1704 on his work computer, an Olivetti M24, and writes his first virus removal tool.
1997
Kaspersky Lab is founded
The company is established on June 26, 1997.
2001
Handheld version of Kaspersky
In Russia, Kaspersky Anti-Virus comes with Palm, Handspring, and Sony PDAs.
2003
International expansion
Kaspersky Lab opens offices in Japan, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, and China. Further countries go on to open offices in years to come.
2004
Hourly updates
Kaspersky Lab is the first company in the world to update its antivirus databases hourly.
2007
Kaspersky for Business
The Kaspersky Open Space Security product line for business is introduced.
2008
Foundation of GReAT
The Global Research and Analysis Team is founded.
2009
First Security Analyst Summit conference
Kaspersky Lab holds its first conference for researchers and analysts from all over the world.
2009
First Antarctic expedition
The first Antarctic expedition sponsored by Kaspersky Lab takes place. This expedition sparks a close relationship between Kaspersky Lab and travel.
2010
Partnership with Formula 1
Kaspersky Lab and Scuderia Ferrari, a Formula 1 team, announce their partnership. Later on, the Kaspersky motor sport team is founded.
2012
Green bear
Our mascot appears: A green bear named Midori Kuma. The mascot goes on to visit Antarctica as well as other continents.
2013
Agreement with INTERPOL
Kaspersky Lab announces its cooperation with INTERPOL.
2013
New office
The company's Moscow headquarters move to a new office. Within several months, an elephant sculpted by Salvador Dali appears in the building.
2015
Biochip implant
Several Kaspersky Lab employees implant biochips into their hand to understand what advantages and threats mankind faces with body augmentation.
2016
No More Ransom initiative
A joint initiative by Kaspersky Lab, Europol, and Intel Security, the campaign targets ransomware, including Trojan encryptors and their creators.
2017
KasperskyOS announcement
Our own secure operating system – in development for 11 years – was finally launched. It protects critical infrastructure against all threats, including unknown ones.
2018
Global Transperancy Intiative
Kaspersky Lab launches the Global Transparency Initiative, reflecting the company’s ongoing commitment to assuring the integrity and trustworthiness of its products.
2019
Rebranding
Kaspersky Lab becomes Kaspersky, with a mission focused on ‘Building a safer world’. The new branding reflects the evolution of our business focus from ’cybersecurity’ towards the wider concept of ‘Cyber Immunity’.
2020
Supporting the community during the pandemic
Kaspersky supports healthcare institutions by offering free licenses for its core endpoint security products to hospitals and clinics worldwide, and contributes to a number of other health initiatives.
2022
Burj Khalifa success
Kaspersky takes top enterprise cybersecurity to the heights of Burj Khalifa, Dubai, illuminating the world’s tallest building with our brand colors and message of global security.
2023
Sustainability report
Kaspersky releases its first sustainability report, marking a milestone in its commitment to environmental responsibility and social governance.
2025
Kaspersky enters new business area with the launch of the Kaspersky eSIM Store
In 2025, Kaspersky entered a new market segment with the launch of the Kaspersky eSIM Store, an app for selecting, purchasing, and activating eSIMs, available in more than 150 countries
2026
Building a Cyber Immune future
Today, Kaspersky is on its way to deliver its mission of building a safer world, driving the future of cybersecurity forward and making Cyber Immunity a reality for everyone.

Living our values every day

These values guide us on our mission to build a safer world.

Be there for you
We never lose sight of the people we build our solutions for. Without our customers we wouldn’t exist, so we put them first.
Be committed experts
Through our recognized technology expertise, we’re committed to providing our customers with safety and confidence, so they know they can trust us.
Be cleverly inventive
We're tirelessly looking for new, smart solutions and always striving to reach new levels of cybersecurity excellence.
Be powered by challenges
We constantly challenge ourselves and the status quo to do what others can't or won’t do in the cybersecurity space.

Building a more sustainable digital world

Explore Kaspersky’s transparency, education, and sustainability efforts in recent years.

Transparency

We are transparent in how we work and protect you

We maintain an honest dialogue with our stakeholders, share our expertise and technical findings with the world’s security community and strive to enhance the transparency of our solutions.

Kaspersky's Global Transparency Initiative (GTI) enhances trust.

Learn more 
Education

We share knowledge and educate minds

We promote worldwide knowledge of cybersecurity, sharing experience from world-class experts and supporting young talent in IT.

Kaspersky Academy offers cybersecurity training for individuals, organizations, and professionals.

Learn more 
Sustainability

We create a sustainable digital world

Our mission is to build a secure digital world so that people can take advantage of the power of technology to improve life on the planet.

Kaspersky’s sustainability report shows our commitment to environmental responsibility and social governance.

Learn more 

Proven expertise. Proven impact.

Kaspersky has grown into a global powerhouse with five main centers of expertise.

Kaspersky’s Global Research and Analysis Team (GReAT) is a world-renowned group of cybersecurity experts specialising in the investigation of APT attacks, cyber espionage, and global cybercrime trends.

With members across the globe, GReAT monitors over 200 APT groups and provides in-depth intelligence reports to help clients combat advanced threats effectively.

Kaspersky Threat Research analyzes new cyberthreats to strengthen our products’ defenses against malware, phishing, and spam.

They also ensure the security of Kaspersky solutions through secure development and vulnerability management.

Kaspersky AI Technology Research leverages AI and machine learning to enhance threat detection, alert triage, and response.

From detecting malware and phishing to using GenAI for advanced insights, our solutions automate security processes and protect complex systems.

Kaspersky Security Services supports large enterprises with advanced threat detection, response, and security assessments.

Our global team manages incidents, enhances security operations, and monitors digital threats, helping organizations minimize risks and strengthen their defenses.

Kaspersky ICS CERT is a global research center focused on securing industrial automation and M2M systems.

The team analyzes vulnerabilities, assists in incident response, and provides threat intelligence to protect industries worldwide.



Cyber Immunity starts here

After years of combating cyber threats, Kaspersky has reached a new frontier: KasperskyOS. It’s more than just software – it’s the foundation of a Cyber Immune future.

With security at its core, KasperskyOS resists attacks by design, ensuring stability and trust in critical systems like IoT and industrial control. This is Kaspersky’s ultimate vision: a world where safety is a built-in property, not an afterthought.

From one solution to global protection In 1989, Eugene Kaspersky's computer was infected by the Cascade virus. This single moment went on to shape the future of the entire cybersecurity industry. Starting with the fight against one virus, Eugene then grew Kaspersky into a global leader in cybersecurity, protecting users and organisations around the world from complex and sophisticated cyber threats. A brief history of Kaspersky Twenty years of Kaspersky’s history and important events in the cybersecurity industry. 1989 Eugene Kaspersky begins fighting viruses Eugene Kaspersky discovers a virus called Cascade.1704 on his work computer, an Olivetti M24, and writes his first virus removal tool. 1997 Kaspersky Lab is founded The company is established on June 26, 1997. 2001 Handheld version of Kaspersky In Russia, Kaspersky Anti-Virus comes with Palm, Handspring, and Sony PDAs. 2003 International expansion Kaspersky Lab opens offices in Japan, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, and China. Further countries go on to open offices in years to come. 2004 Hourly updates Kaspersky Lab is the first company in the world to update its antivirus databases hourly. 2007 Kaspersky for Business The Kaspersky Open Space Security product line for business is introduced. 2008 Foundation of GReAT The Global Research and Analysis Team is founded. 2009 First Security Analyst Summit conference Kaspersky Lab holds its first conference for researchers and analysts from all over the world. 2009 First Antarctic expedition The first Antarctic expedition sponsored by Kaspersky Lab takes place. This expedition sparks a close relationship between Kaspersky Lab and travel. 2010 Partnership with Formula 1 Kaspersky Lab and Scuderia Ferrari, a Formula 1 team, announce their partnership. Later on, the Kaspersky motor sport team is founded. 2012 Green bear Our mascot appears: A green bear named Midori Kuma. The mascot goes on to visit Antarctica as well as other continents. 2013 Agreement with INTERPOL Kaspersky Lab announces its cooperation with INTERPOL. 2013 New office The company's Moscow headquarters move to a new office. Within several months, an elephant sculpted by Salvador Dali appears in the building. 2015 Biochip implant Several Kaspersky Lab employees implant biochips into their hand to understand what advantages and threats mankind faces with body augmentation. 2016 No More Ransom initiative A joint initiative by Kaspersky Lab, Europol, and Intel Security, the campaign targets ransomware, including Trojan encryptors and their creators. 2017 KasperskyOS announcement Our own secure operating system – in development for 11 years – was finally launched. It protects critical infrastructure against all threats, including unknown ones. 2018 Global Transperancy Intiative Kaspersky Lab launches the Global Transparency Initiative, reflecting the company’s ongoing commitment to assuring the integrity and trustworthiness of its products. 2019 Rebranding Kaspersky Lab becomes Kaspersky, with a mission focused on ‘Building a safer world’. The new branding reflects the evolution of our business focus from ’cybersecurity’ towards the wider concept of ‘Cyber Immunity’. 2020 Supporting the community during the pandemic Kaspersky supports healthcare institutions by offering free licenses for its core endpoint security products to hospitals and clinics worldwide, and contributes to a number of other health initiatives. 2022 Burj Khalifa success Kaspersky takes top enterprise cybersecurity to the heights of Burj Khalifa, Dubai, illuminating the world’s tallest building with our brand colors and message of global security. 2023 Sustainability report Kaspersky releases its first sustainability report, marking a milestone in its commitment to environmental responsibility and social governance. 2025 Kaspersky enters new business area with the launch of the Kaspersky eSIM Store In 2025, Kaspersky entered a new market segment with the launch of the Kaspersky eSIM Store, an app for selecting, purchasing, and activating eSIMs, available in more than 150 countries 2026 Building a Cyber Immune future Today, Kaspersky is on its way to deliver its mission of building a safer world, driving the future of cybersecurity forward and making Cyber Immunity a reality for everyone. Living our values every day These values guide us on our mission to build a safer world. Be there for you We never lose sight of the people we build our solutions for. Without our customers we wouldn’t exist, so we put them first. Be committed experts Through our recognized technology expertise, we’re committed to providing our customers with safety and confidence, so they know they can trust us. Be cleverly inventive We're tirelessly looking for new, smart solutions and always striving to reach new levels of cybersecurity excellence. Be powered by challenges We constantly challenge ourselves and the status quo to do what others can't or won’t do in the cybersecurity space. Building a more sustainable digital world Explore Kaspersky’s transparency, education, and sustainability efforts in recent years. Transparency We are transparent in how we work and protect you We maintain an honest dialogue with our stakeholders, share our expertise and technical findings with the world’s security community and strive to enhance the transparency of our solutions. Kaspersky's Global Transparency Initiative (GTI) enhances trust. Learn more Education We share knowledge and educate minds We promote worldwide knowledge of cybersecurity, sharing experience from world-class experts and supporting young talent in IT. Kaspersky Academy offers cybersecurity training for individuals, organizations, and professionals. Learn more Sustainability We create a sustainable digital world Our mission is to build a secure digital world so that people can take advantage of the power of technology to improve life on the planet. Kaspersky’s sustainability report shows our commitment to environmental responsibility and social governance. Learn more Proven expertise. Proven impact. Kaspersky has grown into a global powerhouse with five main centers of expertise. GReAT team GReAT team Threat Research Threat Research AI Technology Research AI Technology Research Security Services Security Services ICS CERT ICS CERT Kaspersky’s Global Research and Analysis Team (GReAT) is a world-renowned group of cybersecurity experts specialising in the investigation of APT attacks, cyber espionage, and global cybercrime trends. With members across the globe, GReAT monitors over 200 APT groups and provides in-depth intelligence reports to help clients combat advanced threats effectively. Kaspersky Threat Research analyzes new cyberthreats to strengthen our products’ defenses against malware, phishing, and spam. They also ensure the security of Kaspersky solutions through secure development and vulnerability management. Kaspersky AI Technology Research leverages AI and machine learning to enhance threat detection, alert triage, and response. From detecting malware and phishing to using GenAI for advanced insights, our solutions automate security processes and protect complex systems. Kaspersky Security Services supports large enterprises with advanced threat detection, response, and security assessments. Our global team manages incidents, enhances security operations, and monitors digital threats, helping organizations minimize risks and strengthen their defenses. Kaspersky ICS CERT is a global research center focused on securing industrial automation and M2M systems. The team analyzes vulnerabilities, assists in incident response, and provides threat intelligence to protect industries worldwide. Cyber Immunity starts here After years of combating cyber threats, Kaspersky has reached a new frontier: KasperskyOS. It’s more than just software – it’s the foundation of a Cyber Immune future. With security at its core, KasperskyOS resists attacks by design, ensuring stability and trust in critical systems like IoT and industrial control. This is Kaspersky’s ultimate vision: a world where safety is a built-in property, not an afterthought.
